Inverse-frequency class weights were combined with a validation-recall component derived from checkpoint 97. Both components were standardized across classes; the recall component was amplified using percentile-based multipliers. The combined weights were shifted so the minimum weight was 1 and then rescaled so the mean weight was 1.
notes: Checkpoint 108 was later reloaded to begin the next weighting subphase at epoch label 109.

class_weight_strategy: Per-class validation recall from checkpoint 108 was converted to a recall penalty, (1 - recall) × 100. The inverse-frequency component and the recall-penalty component were standardized across classes. The standardized inverse-frequency component was divided by 2.5 and the standardized recall-penalty component was multiplied by 2.5; the two components were added and the resulting weights were shifted so the minimum weight was 1.
notes: Checkpoint 108 was reloaded before epoch label 109. Training then continued through checkpoint 120.

class_weight_strategy: Per-class validation recall from checkpoint 120 was converted to a recall penalty, (1 - recall) × 100.
